Contradicts polished design of main app.

ai_look: tan/beige banner is dated color choice

680A.why: Error state design undermines the polish of the main app. Tan/beige warning banner feels incongruous with the light neutral palette elsewhere—suggests legacy code or inconsistent theme. Large empty transcript area is visually punitive rather than reassuring. Error message is functional but lacks personality or encouragement. The tab structure (原文/翻訳/ライプ) is left hanging in empty space, creating visual awkwardness. Better design would integrate permission request more gracefully into the flow or provide placeholder content to guide user attention.
